title: Fairness and Robustness of CLIP-Based Models for Chest X-rays

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot classification performance disparities (AUC, adjusted AUPRC) across different patient age groups, and training supervised classifiers (Linear Probe, k-NN, MLP) to predict age directly from the image embeddings.

Evaluating zero-shot classification performance disparities (AUC, adjusted AUPRC) between male and female patients, and training supervised classifiers to predict patient sex from the image embeddings.

Evaluating zero-shot classification performance disparities (AUC, adjusted AUPRC) across different patient racial groups, and training supervised classifiers to predict patient race from the image embeddings.
